messages:
Iris (SE): Heads-up: Acme POC is failing intermittently. Function-calling + json_mode producing malformed payloads and we're hitting rate limit 429s during stress tests. Need triage.
Sam (AE): Demo on Monday, customer is blocked. Any quick mitigations?
Iris (SE): Example from app log: `ValueError: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 1 column 23` — payload sometimes comes prefixed with `RESULT:
` or double-escaped like `\\"entities\\": [...]`.
Jordan (Platform Eng): Are they streaming? Streamed chunks can split JSON objects which breaks strict parsers.
Iris (SE): Yes default client uses stream=true.
Jordan (Platform Eng): Quick options: 1) set stream=false for the POC; 2) use json_mode:"relaxed" if available; 3) set a conservative max_output_tokens to avoid truncation; 4) client-side sanitization/schema validation (ajv).
Iris (SE): Can you drop a snippet I can paste to the customer?
Jordan (Platform Eng): Sure: `{"call":{"name":"parse_entities"}, "json_mode":"relaxed", "stream":false, "max_output_tokens":600}` and in client run `try { parse(JSONstring); } catch { run sanitizer to extract first {...} block }`.
Sam (AE): About 429s — they're reproducible during load. Headers show `retry-after: 20`. Customer worried retries will multiply costs.
Tess (SRE): For hosted tiers recommend exponential backoff with jitter (base 300ms, cap 8s). Retries are billed as requests. For demos we can request a temporary quota bump if you provide expected RPS and time window.
Sam (AE): I'll ask them for QPS numbers. Can SRE fast-track a short bump for the demo?
Tess (SRE): I can open a temporary exception. Please include channel name, start/end times, and peak RPS.
Marta (Security): Also flag: Acme's security team wants assurance on logs and key management. Hosted logs retention is 30 days by default; Dedicated/Private supports customer KMS and private control plane.
Iris (SE): They also have a client that serializes JSON into a string field which caused double-escaping. Any mitigation?
Jordan (Platform Eng): Avoid double serialization: pass function args as native objects if SDK supports it. If using an HTTP POST, ensure body isn't JSON.stringified twice. If unavoidable, decode once on client before sending to the model.
Sam (AE): Customer asked for a deterministic validation step before we accept model outputs.
Jordan (Platform Eng): Add a lightweight schema check: ajv.validate(schema, payload). If invalid, return a soft-failure and either retry with clarified prompt or fallback to a simpler model. Also require the model to emit only the JSON object in the system prompt and add stop tokens.
Iris (SE): Any tips to strip benign prefixes like `OK:
` safely?
Jordan (Platform Eng): Heuristic: trim non-whitespace before first `{` and after last `}` then attempt parse. Log the raw response for debugging. Not perfect but OK for POC.
quota-bot: Temporary quota request created (#QB-2017)  please tag @Tess with expected RPS/time window.
Iris (SE): I'll gather the load numbers and apply the non-stream snippet. Will also prepare a short runbook with sanitizer code and schema checks for the customer.
Sam (AE): Please cc me on the quota ticket and runbook.
Tess (SRE): Acknowledged. Once we have numbers I'll reply on the ticket.
Iris (SE): Closing update: disabling stream + client-side sanitizer resolved parse errors in our repro. Still collecting demo RPS for quota bump.
